notes.title: Shepherd 0.1.2
notes.content:
Shepherd 0.1.2 comes with an asssortment of bugfixes and tweaks that improve the game experience. There are a number of bugs we are still working on with fixes coming in the next several weeks!

[list]
[*]Shepherd Model no longer sinks into the ground during camping
[*]Shepherd Model no longer dissappears after camping
[*]Added more decorations to starting area
[*]Added an all new loading screen
[*]Adjusted skybox colors
[*]Adjusted UI colors to be more intuitive
[*]Fixed strange rifts in the map
[*]Added barriers across the map to prevent the player from getting outside the playable level
[*]Fixed several bugs related to tutorials
[*]Fixed several bugs related to the menu UI (several more still to come with the next update!)
[*]Other minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.1
notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes and tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sheep drinking unreliability fixed
[*] Barriers to stop players from walking off the map
[*] Tweaked animation on the introduction text
[*] Tweaks to the locations of tutorials so that they are more intuitive
[*] Reconfiguration of obstacle locations
[*] Fixed several instances of floating objects
[*] Fixed several issues that arose when players interacted with the camping system
[*] Small updates to some of the music tracks
[*] Assortment of other minor fixes
[*] Updates to the credits
[/list]

[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] All new menu system with graphical, audio, and controls/keybinds settings
[*] Fade out once the end of the currently playable level is reached
[*] New face cameras for sheep
[*] Updated decorations across various points of the map.
[*] Magical footprint tracking enabled
[/list]
